source.title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
source.text: Anthropic is launching some new Claude AI features to help software engineers ship code. As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests. Engineers have already been able to take advantage of Claude's code review capabilities thanks to the Code Review feature, which was announced in March and became generally available in October . What's new alongside Claude Ship are the PR Steward and Claude Approvals agents, which are launching in beta today.
